family_title_en: Spell words with qu and x

stages.ix_title: Spell words with qu and x
stages.choice_rule: Four whole-word spellings of one roots-list word that uses qu or x. Exactly one choice is spelled correctly. The other three are wrong spellings of that same word. Do not use a different real word, except quiet versus quite on tier 3. No IPA, no sound slashes, and no lone sounds.

gold_items.stem: A woman with a gold crown.
An animal with a bushy tail.
She can run and jump fast.
A home for a small toy.
The little house is soft and still.
Something you ask the teacher in class.

roots: Use a short kid clue about school, home, food, pets, play, family, or weather. Do not put the correct word in the stem.
Qu words: queen, quick, quiet, quietly, quilt, question, quite, quote, squeeze, squeak. X words: box, fox, six, fix, next, text.
Tier 1 wrong spellings drop a letter or use a plainly wrong letter, such as qen for queen or foks for fox.
Tier 2 wrong spellings write qu as kw or qw, and write x as ks or cks.
Tier 3 wrong spellings change one letter, swap two letters, or set quiet against quite.
Choices are whole words. No IPA, no sound slashes, and no lone sounds such as kw or ks.
No brand names and no real names. If a stem needs a person, use <NAME> and set swap_slots NAME to names.txt.

tier_rules.1: Easy clue of four to six words and a common word such as queen, fox, or six. Wrong spellings are obvious at a glance.
tier_rules.2: Normal Grade 2 clue of five to seven words. Distractors are close: qu versus kw, or x versus ks.
tier_rules.3: Hard near misses on words such as question, or quiet versus quite. Only one letter is wrong, or two letters trade places.

qu_together.en: Q and u stay side by side. This word uses qu.
qu_together.ko: q와 u는 붙어 있습니다. 이 단어는 qu를 씁니다.

x_at_end.en: This word ends with the letter x, not with k and s.
x_at_end.ko: 이 단어는 k와 s가 아니라 글자 x로 끝납니다.

qu_not_kw.en: Do not start this word with kw. Start it with qu.
qu_not_kw.ko: 이 단어는 kw로 시작하지 않습니다. qu로 시작합니다.

x_not_ks.en: Do not write k and s in this word. Use the letter x.
x_not_ks.ko: 이 단어에 k와 s를 쓰지 마세요. 글자 x를 씁니다.

quiet_not_quite.en: Quiet means soft and still. Quite is a different word.
quiet_not_quite.ko: Quiet는 조용하다는 뜻입니다. Quite는 다른 단어입니다.

question_spell.en: Question starts with qu. Keep every letter in its place.
question_spell.ko: Question은 qu로 시작합니다. 글자 순서와 수를 지키세요.
